name: Constellation Canvas
description: Paint the night sky with living stars and create celestial music through constellation patterns. Click to place twinkling stars, drag to connect them into constellations, and watch meteors streak across your cosmic canvas.
author: Wavelength Consulting

controls.mouse: Click to place stars, drag to connect constellations

features: Interactive star placement with 6 different colors
Procedural celestial music based on star position and color
Harmonic melodies when stars are connected
Magical meteor shower effects with sparkly trails
Twinkling star animations with ethereal glow
Gentle floating motion and pulsing connections

technical.audio: Web Audio API for procedural celestial music
technical.performance: Optimized particle system with lifecycle management
